title: Fred Everiss, keeping Albion alive.
body: Fred Everiss became Albion’s secretary-manager in 1902, in an era when administration and running the team were closely bound together. The club’s retrospective describes financial crises, the loss of a stand to fire and repeated efforts to keep the business afloat.

Everiss and Billy Bassett helped carry Albion through those difficulties. It is easy for a history to move directly between trophies; his story explains some of the work required for the club to survive long enough to win them.
